what_i_found: Time of day is a function of distance: one lap runs from night through dawn, day and dusk and back, and the sky, sun, street lights, drying road and music all blend from that single number, so the city changes under you with no loading screen. The night street has no character light at all; heroes, dogs and coins are lit only by the lanterns, signs and vending machines they pass, which is what makes them sit in the scene. Every hero, garment and colourway is procedural Three.js code built from approved concept boards, so you can re-dress a character on a live, waving stage and wear it straight into the run.
